claims.statement: For the explicitly encoded heterogeneous trees with branch profiles (2,3,4) at p=7 and (2,2,4,3) at p=8, the exact weighted deletion-plus-exactly-two-neighbor-insertion network saturates all upper supply: respectively 1563/1563 and 8751/8751. Their full selected aggregates are respectively -1218 and -5434.
claims.scope: Only the two labeled trees, their computed eligible ranks, and the finite relation networks specified in REPORT.md and EVIDENCE.json.
claims.reason: The replay enumerates all independent sets, evaluates every original-leaf selector from T-v, computes every selected summand, constructs all literal deletion and exactly-two-neighbor switch edges, and checks exact integer flow conservation and capacities. This is complete for the two finite instances only.

limitations: The two bounded flows establish no result for other profiles or arbitrary ordinary trees.
No orbit quotient or symmetry-lifting theorem was used or reviewed; the separate homogeneous T_m certificates are outside this bounded direct-set computation.
The observed negative sums are not a universal conclusion, and the route found no eligible deficient cut counterexample.
